shared: New independently specified mobile personal task planner. White canvas, date/week navigation, category groups and task controls. No brand header, KPI cards, marketing, demo notices, divider bars or desktop adaptation. Host supplies semantic markup/layout/assets; local model styles units, then separately generates behavior. This is assisted transfer, not proof of independent full-product parity. All text>=14px and weight>=500. Native checkbox/select affordances stay native. Shared assembly owns outer spacing and rows. No actual tasks are seeded; filled-state fixtures will be inserted by evaluation through the real create flow. List-management correction: date/calendar is read navigation;the existing list-edit action belongs inside main task list,not the date header. Host moves existing semantic markup only;local model owns scoped CSS adjustment. No new visible label,heading,brand,feature or desktop variant. Current refinement preserves title reading width in enlarged editing rows;supersedes the old host-chosen always-inline Delete relation only in the private versioned experiment. Native checkbox remains first-line;title/control content and typography stay unchanged. Shared task-row/task-toggle defaults are read-only fallback rules;the declared scoped overrides provide natural wrapping.
